newsitem.title: GERMANY: Global One wins Israel phone licence.
newsitem.headline: Global One wins Israel phone licence.

text.p: Deutsche Telekom AG, the German phone giant, said on Wednesday that its Global One venture with France Telecom and Sprint Corp was part of a consortium that won a licence to operate an international public phone network in Israel.
The consortium, called Barak I.T.C., includes Israeli firms Clalcam Ltd and Matav and marks the first time that Global One's owners bidded jointly on a contract.
